points.why: Recommends building the model now with guessed numbers and notes explicit equations surface disagreements the sketch hides.
Never has each lead write their own equations and compare them before running.
Steps the model forward by hand in a table and uses one-at-a-time sensitivity swings to find which guesses to measure first.
No guard against anchoring, such as independent estimates or not letting first-draft guesses become defaults.

pitfalls.why: Explicitly rejects waiting for data before quantifying.
